verdict.rationale: API Skills run inside Anthropic's code execution environment, a container specified via the `container` parameter (docs-10, docs-23), which implies isolated execution. Plugins and skills can also be tested locally with `--plugin-dir` before distribution (docs-41). Adjacent safeguards exist: hooks can block destructive commands (docs-91) and file checkpointing can restore files (docs-92). However, none of the evidence describes a sandbox environment explicitly separated from production data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/staging mode isolated from production data, documented data-isolation guarantees for the code execution container, hands-on or independent corroboration.
